name: CTA value-proposition
question: Does concrete "documents/evidence" copy convert more readers than narrative copy?
variant_b: Band headline+subhead = benefit copy highlighting evidence + documents
reader_observable: Reader sees different copy on the homepage band
decision: Shipped copy = variant B permanently (evidence-first, consistent with constitution); tracking-ready for later MVT

name: CTA placement
question: Does the newsletter CTA at the fixed story-end position convert a returning reader better than an inline placement?
reader_observable: Reader sees the CTA at a different point in the reading flow
success_metric: newsletter_started per placement + story_completed held flat
decision: Control (story-end) shipped; inline placement retained as component-ready variant

name: Post-confirmation related content
question: Do related-story links after successful confirmation increase continued reading?
variant_b: Confirmation additionally lists two canonical story links by topic
reader_observable: Reader can continue reading immediately after subscribing
success_metric: related_story_clicked + story_completed in the 7-day confirmed cohort
decision: Control shipped (honest no-overreach default); links designed and ready
